info.title: Club Platform HTTP API
info.description: Complete route catalogue of the Club Platform server (pilot 1.0, schema 18). All business and authentication routes live under /api/v1; /health is unversioned. The server binds 127.0.0.1 only and is published through an HTTPS reverse proxy. Browser access requires the configured portal origin. Detailed payloads for finance, banking, documents, licensing and list lifecycle are in the module-specific specifications next to this file. This file is checked against the registered server routes by tests/check_openapi_routes.py.
